scripts.pod-install: cd ios && bundle exec pod install && cd ..
scripts.bundle:ios: npx react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --bundle-output ios/main.jsbundle --sourcemap-output ios/main.jsbundle.map  --dev false --platform ios --sourcemap-output ios/main.jsbundle.map --reset-cache
scripts.bundle:android: npx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --sourcemap-output android/index.android.bundle.map --assets-dest android/app/src/main/res --reset-cache && rm -rf ./android/app/src/main/res/drawable-* && rm -rf ./android/app/src/main/res/raw
scripts.start-rc:
node -e "console.log('
📋 RC RELEASE CHECKLIST
========================
1. ✅ Cut rc-{version} branch from dev
2. ✅ Bump version: npm run bump-patch (or minor/major)
3. ✅ Commit & push to rc branch → triggers draft release
4. ✅ Bug fixes pushed to rc → draft auto-updates
     ℹ️  Each new TEST build (TestFlight/closed testing) of this SAME version: npm run bump-build (build number only). Only bump-patch when starting a NEW version.
5. ✅ Update notes: add highlights for this release to src/assets/releaseNotes.js (drives the in-app What is New modal)
6. ✅ Generate store notes: npm run release-notes (reads releaseNotes.js); commit the App Store + Play .txt files it writes
7. ✅ Finalize the version: npm run cut-rc → freezes its draft, next commits start the next version
8. ✅ Merge rc → master
9. ✅ Tag on master: git tag v{version}
10. ✅ Push tag: git push origin v{version} → publishes official release

⚠️  REMINDERS:
  - Edit releaseNotes.js, NOT the store .txt files — npm run release-notes overwrites them
  - Run release-notes after finalizing releaseNotes.js so the stores match the app
  - Run cut-rc when a version is DONE, so its changelog stops growing
  - Always tag on MASTER not rc
  - Always use v prefix: v2.29.1 not 2.29.1
  - Never manually write changelog
')"
scripts.start-hotfix:
node -e "console.log('
🔥 HOTFIX RELEASE CHECKLIST (patch on master, no rc merge)
=========================================================
1. ✅ git checkout master && git pull origin master
2. ✅ Commit the fix to master (use a fix: ... message)
3. ✅ Bump version: npm run bump-patch
4. ✅ Verify package.json + Android versionName/Code + iOS build number moved
     ⚠️  Check iOS MARKETING_VERSION matches package.json (known stale spot)
5. ✅ Update notes: add highlights for this release to src/assets/releaseNotes.js (drives the in-app What is New modal)
6. ✅ Generate store notes: npm run release-notes (reads releaseNotes.js); commit releaseNotes.js + the App Store + Play .txt files
7. ✅ Push master — NOT an rc-* branch (that fires the draft workflow)
8. ✅ Tag on master: git tag v{version} && git push origin v{version}
     → publishes the official release + changelog
9. ✅ Build/ship: npm run deploy-beta | bundle:android + deploy:android | web-deploy
     ℹ️  Need to REBUILD the same hotfix version (e.g. beta rejected)? npm run bump-build (build number only), then re-ship. Do NOT bump-patch — that starts a new version.
10. ✅ Sentry sourcemaps: npm run upload-sourcemaps
11. 🔁 FORWARD-PORT: cherry-pick the FIX commit into rc-2.30.x (not the bump commit)

⚠️  REMINDERS:
  - Edit releaseNotes.js, NOT the store .txt files — npm run release-notes overwrites them
  - Tag on MASTER, always use the v prefix
  - Do NOT merge rc — but you MUST cherry-pick the fix back into rc
  - Never hand-write the changelog
  - See RELEASE.md for the full checklist
')"
scripts.bump-patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && bundle exec fastlane bump
scripts.bump-minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && bundle exec fastlane bump
scripts.bump-major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && bundle exec fastlane bump
scripts.web-deploy: webpack --mode production --config webpack.config.js && npm run upload-sourcemaps-web

scriptComments.bundle:android: Must be run with every build for android before deploying to PlayStore. Removed the --assets flag because of duplicates.
